name: std::chrono::day::operator+=, std::chrono::day::operator-=
intro:
Adds or subtracts d.count() days from the day value.

1) Equivalent to *this = *this + d;.

2) Equivalent to *this = *this - d;.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to this day after modification.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: If the result would be outside the range [0, 255], the actual stored value is unspecified.

summary: Adds or subtracts d.count() days from the day value.
